First, we must safeguard the Charter of the United Nations and uphold the international rule of law. The Charter is a fundamental guideline for conducting international relations and the cornerstone of the international order. The basic norms of international law, including sovereign equality, non-interference in internal affairs, and the prohibition of the use of force as enshrined in the Charter, must be respected and implemented.
